scripts.check: uvx ruff check . && cargo test --manifest-path native/fairwind-abi/Cargo.toml && bun test tests
scripts.test: bun test tests && cargo test --manifest-path native/fairwind-abi/Cargo.toml && uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.build: bun run build:abi && bun run build:cli
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run build && bun run status
